title: ast.insert_at_anchor response
description: Tagged-union response for ast.insert_at_anchor. `result` discriminates success (`applied`) from the failure modes; `applied` mirrors `result == "applied"` for ergonomic callers.

dry_run.description: Echoes the `dry_run` request flag (set only when `result == "applied"`).

position.description: Echoes the requested position. Set when `result == "applied"` or `result == "invalid_anchor"`.

insertion_byte.description: Byte offset at which the splice landed in the original source. Set only when `result == "applied"`.

indent.description: The leading-whitespace string applied to each line of the inserted content. Set only when `result == "applied"`.

inserted_text.description: The exact text spliced into the file (re-indented and wrapped with newlines). Set only when `result == "applied"`.

anchor.description: Anchor span metadata. Set when `result == "applied"` or `result == "invalid_anchor"`.

match_count.description: Number of anchor matches; set when `result == "ambiguous"`.

before_sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the original source. Set only when `result == "applied"`.

after_sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the post-splice source. Set only when `result == "applied"`.

preview.description: Post-splice source text. Always set when `result == "applied"`; also surfaced on `syntax_error` so callers can inspect the rejected output.

query.description: Echoes the original query; set on `no_match` and `invalid_query` for ergonomic diagnostics.

target_capture.description: Capture name used as the anchor; set on `no_match`.

details.description: Short human-readable diagnostic; set on every non-`applied` result.
